definitions.explanation: The process of collecting information and materials for news reports, articles, or other media content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取材|しゅざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To cover the story at the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取材|しゅざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A reporter came to do an interview.

examples.japanese: {取材|しゅざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。

notes:
{取材|しゅざい} refers to the journalistic process of gathering information for news, articles, or media content. Functions as both a noun and a する verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {取材|しゅざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to gather news, to report on
- {取材|しゅざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be interviewed/covered
- {取材|しゅざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go on a reporting assignment
- {取材|しゅざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to decline an interview

COMPOUNDS:
- {取材|しゅざい}⟦{班|はん}→班：03697_han⟧: reporting team
- {取材源|しゅざいげん}: news source
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{取材|しゅざい}: on-site reporting
- {取材|しゅざい}⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: subject of coverage

COMPONENTS:
{取|しゅ} (take/gather) + {材|ざい} (material). Literally "gathering material" for a story.
